name: Strategic Context for PRD Execution
description: Add Target Architecture and Fragile Areas sections to FADE.md, giving Claude strategic awareness when executing PRDs. Claude will know where the project is heading architecturally and where danger lurks in the codebase, enabling better decisions that align with project direction and avoid known problem areas.

userStories.title: Add strategic sections to FADE.md template
userStories.description: As a developer starting a new FADE project, I want the FADE.md template to include Target Architecture and Fragile Areas sections so I can provide strategic context from day one
acceptanceCriteria: FADE_TEMPLATE includes '## Target Architecture' section after Architecture References
FADE_TEMPLATE includes '## Fragile Areas' section after Target Architecture
Target Architecture section has comment explaining purpose and 'remove when achieved'
Fragile Areas section uses table format with Area and Why columns
Fragile Areas section has comment explaining purpose and 'remove when cleaned up'
Off-Limits section includes note distinguishing it from Fragile Areas
fade init creates FADE.md with these new sections

userStories.title: Update prompt.md to reference strategic sections
userStories.description: As a developer using FADE, I want prompt.md to instruct Claude to check the strategic sections so Claude considers them during PRD execution
acceptanceCriteria: PROMPT_TEMPLATE Session Start checklist includes 'Check **Target Architecture** to understand directional bias'
PROMPT_TEMPLATE Session Start checklist includes 'Check **Fragile Areas** for code requiring extra caution'
These items appear before existing System Context checks
fade init creates prompt.md with updated checklist

userStories.title: Detect missing strategic sections in existing FADE.md
userStories.description: As a developer with an existing FADE project, I want fade update to detect if my FADE.md is missing the recommended strategic sections
acceptanceCriteria: fade update checks if FADE.md exists
fade update checks if FADE.md contains '## Target Architecture' section
fade update checks if FADE.md contains '## Fragile Areas' section
Detection uses simple grep/pattern matching, not parsing
Missing sections are tracked for reporting

userStories.title: Prompt user to add missing sections
userStories.description: As a developer running fade update, I want to be asked if I want the missing strategic sections added to my FADE.md
acceptanceCriteria: If sections missing, fade update shows explanatory message about what they are
Message explains: Target Architecture = directional bias, Fragile Areas = code requiring caution
User is prompted with [y/N] confirmation
Default is N (no changes without explicit consent)
If user declines, no changes made and update continues normally

userStories.title: Append sections to FADE.md with permission
userStories.description: As a developer who confirms the prompt, I want the missing sections appended to my FADE.md without modifying existing content
acceptanceCriteria: Sections are appended to end of FADE.md (safest insertion point)
Existing FADE.md content is never modified or removed
Only missing sections are added (if one exists, only add the other)
Added sections include placeholder examples for user to customize
Success message tells user to review and customize the sections
Works correctly if FADE.md has no trailing newline

userStories.title: Check mode reports missing sections without prompting
userStories.description: As a developer running fade update --check, I want to see if my FADE.md is missing sections without being prompted to add them
acceptanceCriteria: fade update --check reports missing sections as 'would add: Target Architecture section'
No interactive prompt in --check mode
Missing sections contribute to 'updates available' status
Exit code reflects that updates are available

sectionTemplates.targetArchitecture:
## Target Architecture

<!--
Where we're heading. Bias toward these patterns in all work, even when
the current PRD doesn't directly address them. Remove items when achieved.
-->

- Example: Stateless JWT auth (moving away from sessions)
- Example: All writes through service layer (no direct DB in routes)
- Example: Config-driven values (no hardcoding)
sectionTemplates.fragileAreas:
## Fragile Areas

<!--
Known problem spots. Exercise extra caution here - smaller commits, more
verification, ask before major refactoring. Remove when cleaned up.
-->

| Area | Why it's fragile |
|------|------------------|
| `example/path/` | Example: Changes cascade unpredictably |
| `another/module.py` | Example: Looks simple, always takes 5x longer |

technicalNotes.insertion: Append to end of file - safest approach, user can reorder if desired
technicalNotes.offLimitsNote: Add clarifying note: 'For areas that are risky but not forbidden, see **Fragile Areas**.'
